name: aeo-reporting
description: Measure how a company shows up in AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude), reading by reading.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "cross-env AEO_PORT=3400 npm run dev -w server" "cross-env AEO_PORT=3400 npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
